title: CovNav: Conformal Prediction-Guided Adaptive Inference for Object Goal Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27677v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In object goal navigation (ObjectNav), an embodied agent must find a target object (e.g., "find a bed") in a previously unseen environment, relying on spatial commonsense such as object co-occurrence. Large Language Models (LLMs) encode this commonsense, but deploying them on robots exposes a trade-off between reasoning quality and efficiency: cloud-based models incur latency and privacy risks, whereas small on-device LLMs are fast but prone to hallucinated spatial judgments. Hybrid reasoning LLMs offer both a fast non-thinking mode and a slow thinking mode, which raises a key question for embodied agents: when is slow thinking worth its cost? translated_title: CovNav：基于共形预测引导的目标物体导航自适应推理
translated_abstract: 在目标物体导航中，具身智能体需要在先前未见过的环境中寻找目标物体（例如“找一张床”），并依赖诸如物体共现等空间常识。大型语言模型编码了这种常识，但在机器人上部署它们会面临推理质量与效率之间的权衡：基于云端的模型存在延迟和隐私风险，而小型端侧LLM速度快但容易产生幻觉性的空间判断。混合推理LLM同时提供了快速的非思考模式和缓慢的思考模式，这给具身智能体提出了一个关键问题：什么时候值得付出缓慢思考的代价？我们提出了CovNav，一个无需训练的框架，它通过共形预测（CP）回答了这个问题，将双过程（系统1/系统2）推理转变为不确定性感知的决策。与最近的决策模型（如Jev）类似，CovNav将每个空间查询视为结构化二分类（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: CovNav提出了一种无需训练的框架，利用共形预测来量化空间判断的不确定性，从而自适应地决定混合推理LLM在目标物体导航中何时使用快速“系统1”模式或缓慢“系统2”模式，在推理质量与效率之间实现最优权衡。
en_tdlr: CovNav is a training-free framework that leverages Conformal Prediction to quantify uncertainty in spatial judgments, adaptively deciding when hybrid reasoning LLMs should use fast System 1 versus slow System 2 thinking for object goal navigation, optimally balancing reasoning quality and efficiency.
